name: aio-code-review
description: Runs an adaptive, project-aware code-review workflow and carries Google's engineering code-review playbook it applies. The workflow profiles the project, detects its real lint/type-check/test tooling and house conventions, reviews on two tracks (mechanical + semantic 8-dimension rubric), adversarially verifies each finding, and emits an LGTM verdict against The Standard ("improves code health, not perfection"). Also coaches the reviewer and CL-author roles. Source: github.com/google/eng-practices (CC-BY 3.0).
